content:
Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future: A Paranormal Discussion | Osterhout Free Library in Wilkes-Barre

Monday, December 14, 2026 | 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM

Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future: A Paranormal Discussion takes place at Osterhout Free Library in Wilkes-Barre, PA, on Monday, December 14, 2026, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM.

Paranormal investigator and psychic medium Eleni Dedes will explore perceptions of ghosts, spirits and the paranormal during the Christmas season. The discussion examines paranormal stereotypes and how they shape our understanding of the unknown. Dedes will also share experiences from her investigations, including videos, photographs and accounts of unexplained sounds and other phenomena.

Dedes has conducted 40 paranormal investigations throughout Europe and the United States over the past year. She holds a PhD in Philosophy and Religion and teaches workshops on auras and astral projection.

Admission costs $15 per person, payable upon registration. Seating is limited, and advance registration is required.

Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future in Wilkes-Barre offers an intriguing exploration of the paranormal during the holiday season.
